name: Muslims
overview: Scripture reveals that Muslims trace their lineage to Ishmael, whose name means 'God shall hear,' highlighting God's awareness of his descendants (Genesis 16:11). Christians are called to recognize that faith in Jesus Christ is the exclusive way to eternal life, as He declared Himself the way, the truth, and the life, and that no one comes to the Father except through Him (John 14:6). Jesus' eternal nature is affirmed in His statement 'Before Abraham was, I am,' underscoring His divinity (John 8:58). Believers may face persecution and hatred from all nations, which can include those of Muslim faith, for the sake of Christ (Matthew 24:9). Above all, God's love is universal, offering salvation through His only begotten Son to all who believe (John 3:16).
